## Concurrent frontend implementation
A page redesign requires at least two substantive implementation agents running concurrently: one owns markup/copy, another owns CSS. Launch both before waiting. A serial implementer/reviewer pair does not satisfy this requirement. Tiny single-file fixes are exempt.
Both agents can immediately read the project. Preserve existing class names as the shared contract; markup can add semantic HTML that existing type selectors style. CSS must support the existing demo classes as well as headings, paragraphs, sections and links. Avoid inventing a new class contract that needs another planning round. No two active agents may write the same file.
Aim for a coherent first implementation, not a proposal. After both report, reuse one implementer for a targeted integration/verification pass when needed. Do not spawn a new team to redesign completed work. Additional review is warranted by a concrete correctness risk, not by a desire for another aesthetic opinion. Finish after actual defects are addressed; optional embellishments are not blockers.

helpers.calendarApproach:
## Calendar work
Use the fixed conference day already supplied. get_events requires from/to in HH:mm and accepts at most six hours. Valid adjacent full-day windows are 00:00–06:00, 06:00–12:00, 12:00–18:00, 18:00–24:00; 24:00 is only an end time. Never query the whole day at once.
Independent filtering can be completed per time window: read, apply the user's criterion, make requested changes, and verify the affected window in the same assignment. Because queries return overlapping events, each worker owns only events whose START is within its assigned interval (inclusive start, exclusive end). Do not mutate another worker's events.
Judge relevance from titles, descriptions and all participants' metadata. For timetable selection, resolve conflicting events before deleting alternatives; keep uncertain choices until resolved. Preserve original metadata. Create no events unless requested. Report kept/removed IDs with brief reasons, not the entire source data. A successful removal and a targeted reread support completion; avoid repeated full-day inventories.

tool_descriptions.get_events: Read events overlapping a required local HH:mm interval on the fixed conference day. Both from and to are required; to must be later than from and the interval must not exceed 6 hours. tool_descriptions.remove_event: Remove an event by its exact ID from get_events. Only remove events requested by the user. Returns the complete removed event including all metadata.

tool_descriptions.inspect_photos: Inspect all accessible archived photos of a listing using a vision model.
